images.alt: Yellow and black cordless drill held by professional
images.usage: Hero section right-side visual or background accent. Matches brand colors perfectly.

images.alt: Room with white door and yellow strip, painting and drywall
images.usage: Visual for the Drywall & Painting bento card.
Background or side image for the 'Serving Regina' trust section. Needs heavy overlay.

icons.instruction: Use thick, industrial icons (strokeWidth={2.5} or {3}). Use Wrench, PaintRoller, DoorOpen, Hammer, PhoneCall, Mail, MapPin.

motion.interactions: Crisp, fast transitions (duration-150 or 200). Use hard transforms (e.g., -translate-y-1, shadow-lg) on hover for buttons and cards. No floaty/slow animations. It must feel mechanical and responsive.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure yellow text/buttons on white backgrounds have black borders or black text for contrast. White text on black is high contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-call', data-testid='contact-form-submit').

instructions_to_main_agent: Update tailwind.config.js to include font families: { sans: ['IBM Plex Sans', 'sans-serif'], display: ['Oswald', 'sans-serif'] }.

Use standard HTML tags for layout (div, section) and customize Shadcn components heavily by removing standard rounded corners (use rounded-none) and applying solid black borders to match the industrial Swiss theme.
Implement the single-page scrolling navigation: Header links should scroll to #services, #about, #contact.
Ensure the hero section highlights the primary action (Call 306-942-7345) dominantly.
Make the UI feel robust, structural, and 'construction-like' using bold black borders and high-contrast yellow accents.
